svg.text: SOURCE-HEAD04: observed contours → closed volume control sections (PLAN ONLY)
Unmodified source pixels; colored overlays are observations / planned controls. Depth and source camera remain estimates.
B / JULY head only independent contour envelope
C / held receiving pixels + estimated target edges
D / inspectable planned sections: boundary controls become closed paired rails, not ribbons
JSON maps every labeled control. Cartoons below explain closed sections; they are not actual section topology.
55 exact named surfaces proposed hidden; all original payloads archived. Preserve all CGO13/CGH05 optical resources and fixed anchors.
Closed crown support + narrow closed lobe plates. Closed upper hook + separate lower jaw. Recess rolls inward into covered support.
No annular washer. Mirror paired cross-section rails for coherent opposing profiles. First matched whole PBR+clay; pause before design02.
White dashed receiving boundaries may include hidden segments. Algebraic reprojection is not calibration, likeness or owner acceptance.
